Cloud Sessions: Let Kiro Keep Working Offline

Close your laptop. Kiro keeps going.
Cloud sessions are persistent — they keep running when you disconnect.
Start a task, close your laptop, come back to progress.
Great for long-running builds that don't need you watching.

Episode 76 of theAIgurukul's free Kiro series, a daily short on AWS's agentic IDE. Subscribe for the next one.
